title: Factoring scalars out of a sum of products
statement:
Let $\alpha$ be a finite type, let $a, b \in \bbr$ be constants, and let $f, g : \alpha \to \bbr$ be functions. Then
\[
  \sum_{x : \alpha} (a\, f(x))\,(b\, g(x))
  \;=\; a\, b \sum_{x : \alpha} f(x)\, g(x).
\]
replaced:
For a finite type $\alpha$ and constants $a, b \in \mathbb{R}$ and functions
$f, g : \alpha \to \mathbb{R}$,
\[
  \sum_{x : \alpha} (a \cdot f(x)) \cdot (b \cdot g(x))
  \;=\; a \cdot b \cdot \sum_{x : \alpha} f(x) \cdot g(x).
\]
